name: evidence-v3
goal: Each story gives concrete, observable evidence for at least one world condition
problem: Evidence atoms for economy and markets: is each one clear to Clef and learnable on CPU
note: Two paraphrases (a, b) and one reversed question per atom. Written before any answers were seen.

probes.a: Does {file} report travel, power, water or public services being interrupted?
probes.b: Does {file} describe flights, trains, power or services cancelled, cut off or shut down?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report disrupted services being restored?

probes.a: Does {file} report factories cutting production, closing or standing idle?
probes.b: Does {file} describe manufacturing or industrial output falling?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report factories increasing production or opening?

probes.a: Does {file} report shipping delays, shortages of goods or new trade barriers?
probes.b: Does {file} describe goods being held up, ports blocked or tariffs and sanctions hitting trade?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report trade barriers being lifted or supply chains easing?

probes.a: Does {file} report people or businesses taking up a new digital technology such as AI?
probes.b: Does {file} describe a new app, AI tool or digital service being rolled out or widely used?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report people or businesses abandoning or banning a digital technology?

probes.a: Does {file} report interest rates or borrowing costs going up, or loans getting harder to get?
probes.b: Does {file} say a central bank raised rates or banks are tightening lending?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report interest rates being cut or loans becoming easier to get?

probes.a: Does {file} report share prices, house values or savings falling in value?
probes.b: Does {file} describe a stock market fall, property slump or losses for investors?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report share prices, house values or savings rising?

probes.a: Does {file} report markets swinging sharply or investors panicking?
probes.b: Does {file} describe a sudden market crash, surge or turmoil?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report markets calming or steadying?

probes.a: Does {file} report households or firms struggling with debt repayments?
probes.b: Does {file} describe people or companies falling behind on loans, defaulting or going bankrupt?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report households or firms paying down debt?

probes.a: Does {file} report a government facing a budget deficit, rising debt or spending cuts?
probes.b: Does {file} describe public finances under pressure, a budget shortfall or austerity?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report a government budget improving or debt falling?
